AI_TIME_TO_POWER.label: AI time-to-power
AI_TIME_TO_POWER.summary: Lead‑time evidence shows electricity supply and interconnection are emerging as binding constraints for AI data‑center build‑out, while GPU supply is not highlighted.

evidence.source_name: AI data centers just got a government-mandated fast lane to the grid

evidence.claim: Texas Governor Greg Abbott ordered a statewide audit of AI data‑center projects in the ERCOT interconnection queue to verify electric demand and grid impact.
evidence.why_upstream: The audit focuses on interconnection and power demand, underscoring electricity supply as a key limiting factor for AI deployments.
evidence.source_name: Texas Orders Statewide Audit of AI Data Center Projects

evidence.claim: MSI Economics reports that America’s power build‑out for AI is gated by execution constraints (e.g., equipment and permitting) rather than by demand.
evidence.why_upstream: Execution constraints on power infrastructure, not lack of GPU supply, are identified as the primary bottleneck.
evidence.source_name: Business Wire

expected_next: Monitor transformer lead‑time trends and grid interconnection queue lengths for AI data centers.
Track further regulatory actions (e.g., FERC orders) that aim to accelerate power delivery to AI facilities.
